details: The U.S. Treasury Department sanctioned Iranian cryptocurrency exchange BitBank, its developer, and three associates on Thursday, September 17, 2026. The exchange is accused of facilitating the transfer of hundreds of millions of dollars in Bitcoin to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and processing payments for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz, in alleged efforts to bypass sanctions.
title: US Sanctions Iranian Crypto Exchange for IRGC and Hormuz Payments

details: The ongoing conflict between the U.S. and Iran continues to push up energy prices, with a Congressional Budget Office study projecting an additional 0.6 percentage point increase in the annual inflation rate by the first quarter of 2027. This surge in fuel and energy costs was a key factor in the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision to raise interest rates for the first time in three years on September 16, 2026, impacting global financial markets and consumer spending.
title: US-Iran War Drives Inflation, Federal Reserve Raises Interest Rates
